text:
maria: Quick follow-up to the fallthroughs RFC — I think we should formalize a lightweight canary + deterministic sample for benching new models before gate admission.

rahul: +1. what's your target sample size? we can't run full bench for every push.

maria: thinking 100 stratified by input-length buckets (short/med/long) + 5 live canary vnodes for latency checks.

jess: stratified sounds good. also add a tiny adversarial set for hallucination spikes.

mike: one more constraint: KV-cache parity. If a model has different KV layout we need a shim or fast-fail. otherwise bench comparisons are noise.

sofia: agree. also we need a clear fallback ordering when runtime rejects a model under load. propose: quantized variant -> full fp16 -> short-answer-only variant -> 503 fallback.

maria: exact. here's a config snippet I sketched for the intake gate:

```
onboard_sample:
  deterministic: true
  buckets: [ "short", "medium", "long" ]
  per_bucket: 34  # ~100 total
canary_policy:
  vnodes: 5
  traffic_pct: 0.5
fallback_order:
  - quantized
  - fp16
  - short-answer
  - failover_region
```

rahul: how do we validate quality regressions? thresholds?

jess: require BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-sim thresholds on golden prompts + 1% top-token-distribution KL.

mike: for perf, require p50 latency within 1.3x of baseline and p99 within 2x, else auto-roll back.

sofia: can we auto-bisect? If canary fails, pick lowest recency commit that passes to narrow regression.

maria: yes, add bisect as optional step. I'll open a small RFC addendum with the config and metrics.

maria: action items: (1) i'll open the PR for gate + sample harness, (2) jess will collect adversarial set, (3) mike will draft KV parity shim proposal, (4) rahul to wire canary dashboard alerts.

ci-bot: smoke tests for sample harness passed (0 failures) — https://ci.redwood.internal/1234

rahul: ack, will start dashboard proto today.

mike: i'll prototype shim next week, ping me if you want pair.

jess: uploading adversarial set to s3://redwood-onboard/golden/adversarial-2026-03-21

maria: thanks everyone. i'll link the PR here when ready. :rocket:
